quotes.name: Gods Willing
quotes.flavor: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

quotes.name: Skemfar Avenger
quotes.flavor: Stripped of their divinity, the elves of Skemfar channeled their rage and sorrow into bloody brutality.

quotes.name: Elfsworn Giant
quotes.flavor: He upheld his vow to the elves by watching their woods and blazing their trails.

quotes.name: Flameborn Viron
quotes.flavor:
"Large or small, all will toil for the Great Work."
—Decree of Urabrask

quotes.name: Boggart Brute
quotes.flavor: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

quotes.name: Boltwing Marauder
quotes.flavor: When battling the Kolaghan, consider yourself lucky if lightning strikes the same place only twice.

quotes.name: Innocent Blood
quotes.flavor: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

quotes.name: Dazzling Angel
quotes.flavor: Her wings ripple with impossible colors—a sign that a miracle is on the way.

quotes.name: Aven Envoy
quotes.flavor: Their grieving faces tell far more than a list of casualties ever could.

quotes.name: Hollowhead Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Brilliant! They evolved away from energy-taxing brains and respond only to spinal reflex arcs from the hive mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Nexos
quotes.flavor: The blessed union of gun, claw, and merciless intent is a force to be truly feared.

quotes.name: Kozilek's Predator
quotes.flavor: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: The ancient Chaos Emeralds possess unfathomable power. When all seven Emeralds are gathered, their power is amplified immeasurably.

quotes.name: Qumulox
quotes.flavor: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

quotes.name: Dying to Serve
quotes.flavor:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren

quotes.name: Heartstone
quotes.flavor:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna

quotes.name: Maze Sentinel
quotes.flavor: The route has been known for millennia, but only by those with no means to tell it.

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor: All suns must set.

quotes.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
quotes.flavor: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

quotes.name: Grizzly Ghoul
quotes.flavor: The hunters spent the evening celebrating their kill and the rest of the night running from it.

quotes.name: Pop Quiz
quotes.flavor: "Today is hydromancy? I thought it was amplimancy! I studied for amplimancy!"

quotes.name: War Priest of Thune
quotes.flavor: "Let nothing take away from the purity of swords clashing or of arrows taking flight toward the breast of evil."

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Timeline Inquiry
quotes.flavor: At the Time Variance Authority, Chronomonitors ceaselessly scan existence for temporal misconduct.

quotes.name: The Last Agni Kai
quotes.flavor: Zuko's journey began when he refused to duel his father, but it would end dueling his sister.

quotes.name: Impostor of the Sixth Pride
quotes.flavor: The tribe was as strong as his longing, their territory as vast as his isolation. The changeling knew he had found a home, and a form.

quotes.name: Panther Pounce
quotes.flavor:
"Did you truly think you could run from me?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Reaver Drone
quotes.flavor: Kozilek's brood infiltrates and deceives. The spawn of Ulamog mindlessly consume.

quotes.name: Stromkirk Patrol
quotes.flavor: "You'd best move along, human. Our palates are far less discerning than our master's."

quotes.name: Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second
quotes.flavor: She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.

quotes.name: Tolarian Serpent
quotes.flavor:
"When the fishtails' threats of magic didn't move me, they set their pet on us."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

quotes.name: Silent-Chant Zubera
quotes.flavor: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

quotes.name: Sacred Nectar
quotes.flavor:
"Over the silver mountains,
Where spring the nectar fountains,
There will I kiss
The bowl of bliss;
And drink my everlasting fill. . . ."
—Sir Walter Raleigh, "The Pilgrimage"

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: You've traced the tensions in Ten-Towns to the dwindling reindeer populations ... but what has been hunting them?

quotes.name: Windfall
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Your Plans Mean Nothing
quotes.flavor: "You will crawl through the ashes of your own grand ambitions before I grant you the mercy of death."

quotes.name: Spiraling Embers
quotes.flavor: The akki knew to stay indoors on the days the oni flew their kites.

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

quotes.name: Xanthic Statue
quotes.flavor:
"Until you have lived as a statue, do not talk to me of pigeons."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Paladin of Atonement
quotes.flavor: For every wound there is a blessing; for every death, a reckoning.

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

quotes.name: Ronom Unicorn
quotes.flavor: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

quotes.name: Orzhov Advokist
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

quotes.name: Polymorphist's Jest
quotes.flavor:
"The flies were bothering me."
—Jalira, master polymorphist

quotes.name: Sunlance
quotes.flavor:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

quotes.name: Windborne Charge
quotes.flavor: The merfolk call the sky goddess Emeria. The kor call her Kamsa. The two races agree on little except that she offers many blessings to the faithful.

quotes.name: Luminous Angel
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: "The spread of evil's destruction shall always be matched by the rise of the noble fallen."

quotes.name: Simic Sky Swallower
quotes.flavor:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

quotes.name: Zealous Persecution
quotes.flavor:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

quotes.name: Regal Caracal
quotes.flavor: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

quotes.name: Aspect of Gorgon
quotes.flavor:
"My adopted children are loved no less."
—Pharika, god of affliction

quotes.name: Sungrass Prairie
quotes.flavor:
"So, where is everyone? Don't tell me we've come halfway across the universe and they've all gone out. We should've texted first or something."
—Bill Potts

quotes.name: Zodiac Monkey
quotes.flavor: It lives mainly on fruit, leaves, and the occasional nose.

quotes.name: Pit Trap
quotes.flavor:
"These traps are truly a symbol of great cruelty and sinister cunning."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

quotes.name: Jenny, Generated Anomaly
quotes.flavor: "Time to run again. Love the running."

quotes.name: Flip the Switch
quotes.flavor:
"Works every time! Well, every time they don't explode, anyway."
—Barton, stitcher

quotes.name: Essence Filter
quotes.flavor:
"Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor; all she asks in return is that we keep pure our newly given home in Fyndhorn."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Wall of Diffusion
quotes.flavor:
"The injury was being caught between this world and our own; the insult was to find walls within."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

quotes.name: Ent-Draught Basin
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigor as it coursed upward, right to the tips of the hair.

quotes.name: Flowstone Blade
quotes.flavor:
"Remember the fable of the elf who came upon a cave of gold. In trying to free the largest piece, she was crushed by its weight."
—Karn

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Lowland Giant
quotes.flavor: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

quotes.name: Baithook Angler // Hook-Haunt Drifter
quotes.flavor: Even in death, he casts his lines, forever fishing for reasons long forgotten.

quotes.name: Assassin's Trophy
quotes.flavor: "Who are these . . . freaks? How do they know to fight like that? Answer me, or hang here until you die."

quotes.name: One With the Wind
quotes.flavor:
"River and sea, jungle and sky. Water flows freely between the two halves of the world. We are creatures of the water."
—Shaper Tuvasa

quotes.name: Gods Willing
quotes.flavor: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

quotes.name: Blatant Thievery
quotes.flavor: Centuries of association with the Sun Empire have taught the dinosaurs that shiny things are important.

quotes.name: Angel's Feather
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

quotes.name: Necroduality
quotes.flavor:
"Geralf's prowess continues to grow. He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy."
—Ludevic's laboratory notes

quotes.name: Concentrate
quotes.flavor: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

quotes.name: Stomper Cub
quotes.flavor:
"This one is only a yearling, but it would be wise to move away before we provide it with excellent hunting practice."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Gallant Citizen
quotes.flavor:
"People cheer for that webbed menace. They should be cheering for my son."
—J. Jonah Jameson

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: It is rumored that wild breeds of the species— including those which have retained the capacity for flight—still thrive throughout forests nestled in the vastly unexplored valleys of Abalathia's Spine.

quotes.name: Angelic Protector
quotes.flavor:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Impatience
quotes.flavor: "I'm going to count to three. Three."

quotes.name: Strix Lookout
quotes.flavor: Wise. Watchful. Fashionable.

quotes.name: Great Oak Guardian
quotes.flavor: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

quotes.name: Flametongue Kavu
quotes.flavor:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor:
"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war."
—River Song

quotes.name: Triskelion
quotes.flavor: A brainchild of Tawnos, the Triskelion later proved both versatile and useful.

quotes.name: Vexing Shusher
quotes.flavor: The stench of bloodcap mushrooms on the breath is enough to ward off even the most potent magics, especially when combined with a special chant: "Hushhh."

quotes.name: Honored Heirloom
quotes.flavor: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.

quotes.name: Ranger's Longbow
quotes.flavor: With the right weapon, a fearsome beholder is nothing more than a big floating bullseye.

quotes.name: Eye of Ugin
quotes.flavor: An eye closes. A race awakens.

quotes.name: Biolume Egg // Biolume Serpent
quotes.flavor: ...knowing their hatchlings are more fearsome than anything else that might come along.

quotes.name: Pendelhaven Elder
quotes.flavor: The elder who carries the ancestral mantle of Jacques le Vert is tasked with his ancient mission: to protect the creatures of Pendelhaven.

quotes.name: The Nipton Lottery
quotes.flavor: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Brood Sliver
quotes.flavor: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

quotes.name: Liliana's Elite
quotes.flavor:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Servo Schematic
quotes.flavor: The Consulate prizes innovation when it is dependable and replicable.

quotes.name: Adarkar Sentinel
quotes.flavor:
"We encountered the sentinels in the wastes, near no living thing. Their purpose was inscrutable."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Wanderer's Intervention
quotes.flavor: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion. One mighty slash was enough to take the praetor out of the fight.

quotes.name: Tideforce Elemental
quotes.flavor: Ebb and flow, high tide and low, quick as sand and just as slow.

quotes.name: Ghoultree
quotes.flavor: It uproots entire fengrafs to add to its twisted frame.

quotes.name: Search for Azcanta // Azcanta, the Sunken Ruin
quotes.flavor: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

quotes.name: Omenspeaker
quotes.flavor: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

quotes.name: Koma's Faithful
quotes.flavor: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

quotes.name: Turntimber Symbiosis // Turntimber, Serpentine Wood
quotes.flavor:
"The trees here twist around spikes of mana, feeding off the flowing power."
—Jori En, expedition leader

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Faerie Invaders
quotes.flavor: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

quotes.name: Inkshield
quotes.flavor: "You did it to yourself."

quotes.name: Safeguard
quotes.flavor:
"I'm amused by wasted effort when it's not my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Viashino Sandstalker
quotes.flavor:
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

quotes.name: Terra Stomper
quotes.flavor: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

quotes.name: Battering Ram
quotes.flavor: By the time Mishra was defeated, no mage was foolish enough to rely heavily on walls.

quotes.name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
quotes.flavor:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

quotes.name: Inquisition of Kozilek
quotes.flavor: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

quotes.name: Paradise Druid
quotes.flavor: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

quotes.name: Goblin Wardriver
quotes.flavor:
"A true warrior fights with whatever's handy."
—Qerk of the Secret Warren

quotes.name: Spara's Headquarters
quotes.flavor: To most, the Nido Sanctuary is an office complex. To the Brokers, it's a vault of secrets.

quotes.name: Disfigure
quotes.flavor: "Brave scar or unfortunate tale? It all depends on your pain threshold."

quotes.name: Topaz Dragon // Entropic Cloud
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: What its gaze doesn't wither, its breath surely will.

quotes.name: Ice Storm
quotes.flavor: Nothing could survive in the wake of Storm's blizzard, not even the land itself.

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The staff flared and rattled erratically, every twirl driving the wolf to greater heights of rage.

quotes.name: Seek the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."

quotes.name: Energy Flux
quotes.flavor: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

quotes.name: Elvish Warrior
quotes.flavor: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

quotes.name: Firebolt
quotes.flavor: Reach out and torch someone.

quotes.name: Deadly Brew
quotes.flavor: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.

quotes.name: The Haunt of Hightower
quotes.flavor: It drains vitality from those it touches.

quotes.name: Baloth Gorger
quotes.flavor: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

quotes.name: Graven Cairns
quotes.flavor: Shamans of Kar-Sengir claim that their sun sets because it can no longer bear the gaze of those pain-carved cliffs.

quotes.name: Lost to Legend
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"In the days of Isildur, the Ruling Ring passed out of all knowledge."
—Elrond

quotes.name: Beskir Shieldmate
quotes.flavor: "If we fall today, let us fall with honor, defending our realm from the horrors that would defile it. Forward, shieldmates! To Starnheim!"

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

quotes.name: Glint Hawk
quotes.flavor: Its eyes burned nearly blind by the Whitesun, it hunts by metallic gleam.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

quotes.name: Shrieking Grotesque
quotes.flavor: Orzhov mage-sculptors bring their stone to life before they carve it. The shrieking begins as soon as the mouths are formed.

quotes.name: Coercion
quotes.flavor:
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Mutinous Massacre
quotes.flavor: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

quotes.name: Stitcher's Supplier
quotes.flavor: No part goes to waste.

quotes.name: Rollick of Abandon
quotes.flavor:
"Embrace every moment, for it could be your last."
—Xenagos, god of revels

quotes.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: An angel among angels, she carries the hopes of the world skyward.

quotes.name: Ancient Ziggurat
quotes.flavor: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

quotes.name: Pillar Launch
quotes.flavor: Toph hated flying. "Launching," however, was a trajectory under her control.

quotes.name: Knight of New Alara
quotes.flavor: "I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."

quotes.name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
quotes.flavor: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

quotes.name: Wild Wasteland
quotes.flavor: Some things in the wasteland are best left unexplained.

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

quotes.name: Waker of Waves
quotes.flavor: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

quotes.name: Farmer Cotton
quotes.flavor: "So it's begun at last! I've been itching for trouble all this year."

quotes.name: Abbey Matron
quotes.flavor:
"The Matrons still say Serra is coming back. I bet she never even existed."
—Murat, Death Speaker

quotes.name: Sea's Claim
quotes.flavor:
"Who's the crazy one now!?"
—Torgle, mountaintop boatmaker

quotes.name: Panic
quotes.flavor:
"If you'd been there, you would've run from that deer, too!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

quotes.name: Tromp the Domains
quotes.flavor: Ground into the footprints of the ravaging herd were clumps of salt from Benalia, moss from Llanowar, dust from Hurloon, and ash from as far as Urborg.

quotes.name: Persecute
quotes.flavor: "I want every last one of these tree-hugging, earth-loving, pointy-eared weaklings out of here. Now!"

quotes.name: Reya Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: A beacon of hope for a battered army.

quotes.name: Soul of the Harvest
quotes.flavor: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor: A relic that greatly enhances the magical power of its wielder.

quotes.name: Gingerbrute
quotes.flavor: Sometimes, "as fast as you can" isn't quite fast enough.

quotes.name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

quotes.name: Thrill of Possibility
quotes.flavor: "May we live every day like it's our last. 'Cause you never know when your last will come."

quotes.name: Execute
quotes.flavor:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Blade Sliver
quotes.flavor: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria—much to the dismay of life on Otaria.

quotes.name: Gruul Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

quotes.name: Cathar's Call
quotes.flavor: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.

quotes.name: Merciless Enforcers
quotes.flavor:
"Montana, Fancy Dan, Ox... you guys are *so* brave to keep dressing like that. And I'm the one wearing spandex!"
—Spider-Man

quotes.name: Unseen Walker
quotes.flavor:
"To pass through the jungle: silence, courtesy, ferocity, as the occasion demands."
—Kamau, "Proper Passage"

quotes.name: Stoneforge Masterwork
quotes.flavor: The nomadic kor carry only necessities on their long treks. The coming of the Eldrazi redefined "necessities."

quotes.name: Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder
quotes.flavor: "A pleasure to make your acquaintance. Now, allow me to introduce you to the children."

quotes.name: Chaotic Backlash
quotes.flavor: The concept of thoughtweft fascinates the Nighthearth cult. Imagine, bringing agony to an entire people by torturing just one.

quotes.name: Evie Frye
quotes.flavor: "For every mission, there is a right way and a wrong way. Barging thoughtlessly into combat is, more often than not, the latter."

quotes.name: Order of the Golden Cricket
quotes.flavor:
"Should you take it in mind to ride a springjack, remember: there are easier ways to fly, and harder ways to break your skull."
—Lann of Cloverdell

quotes.name: Tanufel Rimespeaker
quotes.flavor: "A single snowflake can trigger an avalanche. A single insight can do the same."

quotes.name: Goblin Digging Team
quotes.flavor: "From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!" "Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Denying Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The third wind of ascension is Eliminator, clearing Keld's path to victory."
—*Keld Triumphant*

quotes.name: Shore Keeper
quotes.flavor: Over their long life spans, the larger trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.

quotes.name: Raze to the Ground
quotes.flavor: First one, then a second, then a third of the ivory towers fell to the invaders, who moved in a circle around the city like an apocalyptic clock.

quotes.name: Blood Artist
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

quotes.name: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim // Dorothea's Retribution
quotes.flavor: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."

quotes.name: Scryb Sprites
quotes.flavor: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My Betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Encampment Keeper
quotes.flavor: Paladins of the Sanctum Seeker order are an adventurous lot, venturing into the wilds with monstrous mastiffs at their side.

quotes.name: Gideon's Reproach
quotes.flavor:
"Suddenly, Gideon was there with us, clearing the way so that we could escape."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Skysovereign, Consul Flagship
quotes.flavor: Engineers take inspiration form nature when it comes to efficiency and aerodynamics. Why not intimidation too?

quotes.name: Jund Panorama
quotes.flavor: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

quotes.name: Crossway Vampire
quotes.flavor: "Do not flatter Fate. It did not guide you into my clutches tonight. That was all my doing."

quotes.name: Y'shtola Rhul
quotes.flavor: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."

quotes.name: Flooded Shoreline
quotes.flavor:
"Some say the sea is jealous of the land and wishes to climb its heights to meet the sky."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Rising Waters
quotes.flavor: Rising waters, sinking hope.

quotes.name: Commander's Plate
quotes.flavor: Not all beautiful things are fragile.

quotes.name: Gilded Drake
quotes.flavor: Buyer beware.

quotes.name: Executioner's Capsule
quotes.flavor: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Mind Whip
quotes.flavor:
"A mind in agony is a sparrow without wings."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

quotes.name: Elvish Eulogist
quotes.flavor: "No matter how adept our artistic skill, our effigies can never hope to capture the vibrant beauty of a living elf. Perhaps that is truly why we mourn."

quotes.name: Havoc Festival
quotes.flavor:
"We can't control enemies who have no regard for their own survival."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Warrior's Honor
quotes.flavor:
"No person was ever honored for what he received. Honor has been the reward for what he gave."
—Calvin Coolidge

quotes.name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
quotes.flavor: Let the past die so the future might live.

quotes.name: Bloom Tender
quotes.flavor: "What, these old things? They were just lying around, gathering dust. I figured I might as well put them to use."

quotes.name: Ashes of the Abhorrent
quotes.flavor: "Let no trace of the vampires' foulness remain."

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

quotes.name: Ragged Recluse // Odious Witch
quotes.flavor: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."

quotes.name: Consider
quotes.flavor: A moment's pause, doubt chips away the facade, the thin veneer exposed.

quotes.name: Nissa's Renewal
quotes.flavor: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

quotes.name: Ad Nauseam
quotes.flavor: When the task spilled over into undeath, he stopped calling it his life's work.

quotes.name: Hellkite Punisher
quotes.flavor:
"We'll pay no more tribute to that tyrannical lizard. A new age starts today!"
—Mayor Kadrim, now deceased

quotes.name: Bargaining Table
quotes.flavor: Although it looks like a game, business around the table is deadly serious.

quotes.name: Strionic Resonator
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Akal theorizes that it is some sort of signal, resonating beyond this cavern's physical space. But if so, who—or what—is the signal for?"
—Huatli's travel journal

quotes.name: Feed the Serpent
quotes.flavor: He spent the final moments of his existence tumbling down the length of the serpent's jaws, driven mad by the magnitude of the Cosmos.

quotes.name: Kargan Dragonrider
quotes.flavor: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Pooling Venom
quotes.flavor: The land can only hold so much poison before it begins to bite back.

quotes.name: Evangel of Synthesis
quotes.flavor: "Forge the future in metal and oil!"

quotes.name: Orzhova, the Church of Deals
quotes.flavor: Unlike most churches, at Orzhova it's best to pray before you arrive.

quotes.name: Pay No Heed
quotes.flavor:
"Inhale life. Exhale pain."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Hithlain Knots
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"If you will try to run away you must be tied; but we don't wish to hurt you."
—Sam

quotes.name: Abyssal Horror
quotes.flavor: It has no face of its own—it wears that of its latest victim.

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Wrecking Crew
quotes.flavor: They built the neighborhood. They know its weak points. They know all the hiding places. When they come for you, they'll find you and bring the roof down on your head.

quotes.name: Supernatural Stamina
quotes.flavor:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

quotes.name: Court of Grace
quotes.flavor: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

quotes.name: Full Throttle
quotes.flavor:
"You wanted a fight. Now you've got two."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Curse of Shaken Faith
quotes.flavor: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

quotes.name: Vicious Rivalry
quotes.flavor: So intense was their hatred they didn't realize how lonely they'd become. In the end, all they had was each other, and they hated that, too.

quotes.name: Ley Druid
quotes.flavor: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

quotes.name: Qasali Slingers
quotes.flavor: All things will crumble, whether by time or by force.

quotes.name: Despise
quotes.flavor:
"Truth is always a weapon in your enemies' hands."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

quotes.name: Squirrel Nest
quotes.flavor: In the wasteland, the radsquirrels have their eyes out for you.

quotes.name: Hammerheim
quotes.flavor:
"'Tis distance lends enchantment to the view,/ And robes the mountain in its azure hue."
—Thomas Campbell, "Pleasures of Hope"

quotes.name: Spectacular Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: The Future Foundation Suit

quotes.name: Summon: Primal Odin
quotes.flavor: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

quotes.name: Opportunity
quotes.flavor: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

quotes.name: Boon Reflection
quotes.flavor: Kithkin healers chant the clan songs of both their parents over the broth to double its curative effect.

quotes.name: Mist Raven
quotes.flavor:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

quotes.name: Barbflare Gremlin
quotes.flavor:
"You think burning the pie to a crisp was bad? You should see what it did to the chef!"
—Meg, supply runner

quotes.name: Unstoppable Ogre
quotes.flavor: Touma never met a door he didn't hate.

quotes.name: Lurebound Scarecrow
quotes.flavor: It's a fool's race to run if all is lost if it be won.

quotes.name: Sunlance
quotes.flavor:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

quotes.name: Spiteful Sliver
quotes.flavor: Victories against the hive are tragedies.

quotes.name: Lowland Tracker
quotes.flavor:
"I feed my hatred to the righteous and they join my crusade."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

quotes.name: The Waffle Restaurant
quotes.flavor: Prize Card for the Unknown events at MagicCon Atlanta. September 26-28, 2025

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

quotes.name: Enchantress's Presence
quotes.flavor: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"We must never stoop to violence in the name of conquest or hatred, but when evil threatens, we must face it with courage and ferocity."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Ultimecia, Time Sorceress // Ultimecia, Omnipotent
quotes.flavor: "Your vain krusade ends here, SeeDs."

quotes.name: Quicksilver Fisher
quotes.flavor: It no longer needs to eat, but old instincts are put to use ridding the Surgical Bay of spies.

quotes.name: Prophetic Flamespeaker
quotes.flavor: Fire to destroy. Fire to create.

quotes.name: Almost Perfect
quotes.flavor: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Knight of Stromgald
quotes.flavor:
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Polymorphist's Jest
quotes.flavor:
"The flies were bothering me."
—Jalira, master polymorphist

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Death Pits of Rath
quotes.flavor: As the sludge below began to shift and take shapes, Gerrard turned from the railing to Orim. "I suppose," he said, "it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?"

quotes.name: Cyclonic Rift
quotes.flavor:
"When you see what nature is capable of, do not believe you'll be the one to withstand its force."
—*The Stormwright Texts*

quotes.name: Pia's Revolution
quotes.flavor: Pia's passion was directed at the big picture—at making real, lasting change.

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

quotes.name: Well of Lost Dreams
quotes.flavor: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

quotes.name: Killing Wave
quotes.flavor:
"I come looking for demons and I find a plane full of angels. I hate angels."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Busted!
quotes.flavor: "All you gotta do is panic with purpose. And plead your innocence with purpose. And have your mom bail you out with purpose."

quotes.name: Displaced Dinosaurs
quotes.flavor:
"Good grief! It's a stegosaurus. What a splendid specimen."
—The Third Doctor

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Cloud Key
quotes.flavor: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.

quotes.name: Deadly Insect
quotes.flavor: With his newfound sense of self-importance, Squee set his sights on ever-bigger bugs.

quotes.name: Wooden Sphere
quotes.flavor: Strengthened by a thousand limbs.

quotes.name: Nessian Asp
quotes.flavor: It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.

quotes.name: Make a Stand
quotes.flavor: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

quotes.name: Desolate Lighthouse
quotes.flavor:
"The lighthouse where I grew up, my family home. Why am I seeing that now? I haven't thought about that for years."
—Ruth

quotes.name: Young Wei Recruits
quotes.flavor:
"To send the common people to war untrained is to throw them away."
—Confucius, *The Analects* (trans. Lau)

quotes.name: Symbiote Spawn
quotes.flavor: The Life Foundation captured Venom and extracted seeds for newborn symbiotes. Symbiotes they could not control.

quotes.name: Bag of Holding
quotes.flavor: There's no prepared like overprepared.

quotes.name: Briar Patch
quotes.flavor: As easily as the dryads could close a fist, so could the branches and underbrush entangle.

quotes.name: Subterranean Tremors
quotes.flavor: The market is now closed.

quotes.name: Orzhov Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

quotes.name: Compelling Argument
quotes.flavor:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

quotes.name: Benthic Criminologists
quotes.flavor: Scientists from the Simic Combine are regularly seconded to various detective agencies in hopes that sharing their expertise will improve the guild's tarnished reputation.

quotes.name: Blanchwood Armor
quotes.flavor:
"There's never been a dwarven smith who could match the marvels that Gaea herself forges."
—Elvish champion

quotes.name: Goblin Ringleader
quotes.flavor:
*Goblin_Chieftain:* sweet filter!!1! #gobmob
*Thrun_TheLastTroll:* lol glad i wasn't there

quotes.name: Horseshoe Crab
quotes.flavor: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

quotes.name: Cadaver Imp
quotes.flavor: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

quotes.name: Rancid Rats
quotes.flavor: "They're in the walls! Can't you hear them?"

quotes.name: Knight of the Kitchen Sink
quotes.flavor: "Whew. For a minute, I thought I'd forgotten the garlic press."

quotes.name: Confiscate
quotes.flavor:
"The surface world contains nothing I cannot take."
—The Lord of Atlantis

quotes.name: Burning Palm Efreet
quotes.flavor: Even the lion envies the lark.

quotes.name: Great Furnace
quotes.flavor: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

quotes.name: Acquired Mutation
quotes.flavor: The radiation of the wasteland has changed you!

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: When the Great Rift opened across the Galaxy, many Imperial worlds were lost to Chaos.

quotes.name: Frogtosser Banneret
quotes.flavor: The Frogtossers thread feathers, bones, and trophies from past raids into their standards, believing they fuel the warren with the anger of its victims.

quotes.name: Zoologist
quotes.flavor: "With friends like these, who needs people?"

quotes.name: Second Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"The cornfields promise a good yield this season."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor:
"It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

quotes.name: Spirit Mantle
quotes.flavor: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

quotes.name: Wyleth, Soul of Steel
quotes.flavor: "Two things a warrior needs: a strong sword and a strong will."

quotes.name: Walking Wall
quotes.flavor:
"The fortress is not what it seems."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

quotes.name: Managorger Hydra
quotes.flavor:
"Whoever said two heads are better than one never met a hydra before."
—Crocodile Jackson, legendary cowboy

quotes.name: Empyrean Eagle
quotes.flavor: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

quotes.name: Pillage
quotes.flavor:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

quotes.name: Abandon the Post
quotes.flavor: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.

quotes.name: Mistmeadow Witch
quotes.flavor: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

quotes.name: Shady Traveler // Stalking Predator
quotes.flavor: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

quotes.name: Faceless Haven
quotes.flavor: It is everywhere and nowhere, a place unbound by logic, just beyond the real.

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Druid of the Cowl
quotes.flavor: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

quotes.name: Howling Banshee
quotes.flavor: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

quotes.name: Regal Bunnicorn
quotes.flavor:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Rescuer Chwinga
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Fortunately for lost travelers, chwingas' curiosity often gets the better of their shyness.

quotes.name: Fireblast
quotes.flavor: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

quotes.name: Hinterland Hermit // Hinterland Scourge
quotes.flavor: He tried to live far from those he could hurt . . .

quotes.name: Soulbright Flamekin
quotes.flavor: When provoked, a flamekin's inner fire burns far hotter than any giant's forge.

quotes.name: Lingering Death
quotes.flavor:
"Looks bad. I don't know if he'll make it through the night."
—Cabal cleric

quotes.name: Royal Trooper
quotes.flavor:
"Fortune does not side with the faint-hearted."
—Sophocles, *Phaedra*

quotes.name: Seasoned Buttoneer
quotes.flavor: Everyone comments on the buttons, but few appreciate the pedals.

quotes.name: Angelic Blessing
quotes.flavor: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

quotes.name: Smitten Swordmaster // Curry Favor
quotes.flavor: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

quotes.name: Dragonloft Idol
quotes.flavor: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Lumbering Satyr
quotes.flavor:
The satyr carves the path that all of Rushwood follows.
—Cho-Arrim saying

quotes.name: Sylvan Advocate
quotes.flavor: "The land gives of itself. Its abundance provides, even in times of chaos."

quotes.name: Abyssal Gatekeeper
quotes.flavor:
"There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Eater of Days
quotes.flavor: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

quotes.name: Pith Driller
quotes.flavor: After boring up through the crust of Mirrodin, it turned its expertise upon the surface dwellers.

quotes.name: Reflexes
quotes.flavor:
"Be as fast as lightning, and you will be just as deadly."
—Combat trainer

quotes.name: As Foretold
quotes.flavor: "It is returning through the dark. And then, Doctor? Oh, but then he will knock four times."

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

quotes.name: Tel-Jilad Archers
quotes.flavor: They are extensions of the Tangle, stretching its vines into the furthest reaches of the sky.

quotes.name: Doomwake Giant
quotes.flavor: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

quotes.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
quotes.flavor: "I am the blood of the ur-dragon, coursing through all dragonkind."

quotes.name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
quotes.flavor: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

quotes.name: Morkrut Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

quotes.name: Ghostway
quotes.flavor:
"I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty. I saw its face contort in rage but could not hear it snarl."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Viridescent Bog
quotes.flavor: The Master had literally built his army one mutant at a time. Humans, preferably with little radiation damage, were captured and sent to the vats.

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

quotes.name: Spontaneous Generation
quotes.flavor: Saprolings always thrive on the ruins of others, and Mercadia ruins more than most.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Gruul Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"Beyond this gate there are no citizens, only predators and prey."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Argivian Phalanx
quotes.flavor: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
quotes.flavor: "This town swims with such exquisite blood. I will take every drop for my own."

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
quotes.flavor: "Your death will be neither quick nor painless. Agony makes blood so much sweeter."

quotes.name: Kranioceros
quotes.flavor:
"A surly beast, the kranioceros will raise its defenses at the smallest threat. Stay out of sight and downwind, or you'll disrupt its natural migrations."
—Ebrel, godtoucher mentor

quotes.name: Sandstorm
quotes.flavor: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor:
"Hear me, nations of the world! This place now stands uninhabited and ungoverned. Eternal proof that human life cannot stand against the steel of machinery!"
—Ultron

quotes.name: Prowling Nightstalker
quotes.flavor: Silent as a serpent, twisted as a lone bog tree, evil as Tojira's heart.

quotes.name: River Bear
quotes.flavor: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

quotes.name: Spellbound Dragon
quotes.flavor: A king in Jund, a serf in Esper.

quotes.name: Dramatic Finale
quotes.flavor: The enraptured audience barely noticed their programs were suddenly blank.

quotes.name: Plated Crusher
quotes.flavor:
"It might fight the Eldrazi, but don't mistake it for a companion, Gideon. It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

quotes.name: Rain of Daggers
quotes.flavor: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

quotes.name: Vulshok Splitter
quotes.flavor:
"Not my style, but it'll get the job done."
—Nahiri

quotes.name: Steel Leaf Champion
quotes.flavor: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Blade
quotes.flavor: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

quotes.name: Gerrard's Command
quotes.flavor: "Unless you like the idea of becoming some goblin's lunch, get up and move!"

quotes.name: Illegitimate Business
quotes.flavor: Their recipe isn't the only secret.

quotes.name: Reckless Abandon
quotes.flavor: The climax of a warlord's career is always death.

quotes.name: Tributary Instructor
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "Like water between rivers, wisdom must flow freely from one generation to the next."

quotes.name: Hope Estheim
quotes.flavor: "If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."

quotes.name: Quagmire Druid
quotes.flavor: As the druids had devoted their lives to preserving Dominaria, so did they devote their deaths.

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?

quotes.name: Crop Rotation
quotes.flavor: "Hmm . . . maybe lotuses this year."

quotes.name: Familiar's Ruse
quotes.flavor: Because of their capricious nature, faeries can serve as living lenses for disruptive magic.

quotes.name: Pernicious Deed
quotes.flavor: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

quotes.name: Ravenous Chupacabra
quotes.flavor: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

quotes.name: Wall of Fortune
quotes.flavor: "You need a six? All right everyone, she needs a six!"

quotes.name: Farbog Revenant
quotes.flavor: Spiteful geists rise from the muck of the Farbogs, eager to lure travelers to their doom.

quotes.name: Craw Giant
quotes.flavor: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

quotes.name: Griselbrand
quotes.flavor:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Mana Geyser
quotes.flavor: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

quotes.name: Hemlock Vial
quotes.flavor: Just what the doctor ordered.

quotes.name: Reunion of the House
quotes.flavor:
"We stand or fall as a family. All of us."
—Betor

quotes.name: Chastise
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Copy Enchantment
quotes.flavor: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

quotes.name: Vault of the Archangel
quotes.flavor:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Exalted Dragon
quotes.flavor: If dragons excel at anything more than vanity, it is greed.

quotes.name: Jaya's Firenado
quotes.flavor:
"For all their supposed advances, the Phyrexians still aren't fireproof."
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Fresh Start
quotes.flavor:
"I know leaving your old life was no easy choice. Welcome, Novice Sardul."
—Elsha

quotes.name: Nezumi Informant
quotes.flavor: "Tell Boss Umezawa there's a new gang moving in on our territory. I'm forwarding their insignia. Watch for it elsewhere."

quotes.name: Bronzebeak Moa
quotes.flavor: They fight for their home with more loyalty than any conscript.

quotes.name: Turbulent Moor
quotes.flavor:
"Where others see melancholy, I see promise. All our kindness and cruelty make such haunting poetry."
—Shadrix Silverquill

quotes.name: Spider-Bot
quotes.flavor:
"Parker was a fool to waste his time on patrol. I'll have my spider-bots do it for me."
—Superior Spider-Man, Otto Octavius

quotes.name: Ivy Lane Denizen
quotes.flavor: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

quotes.name: Boiling Seas
quotes.flavor: What burns the land, boils the seas.

quotes.name: Blightbeetle
quotes.flavor: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.

quotes.name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
quotes.flavor: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor: L is for Luck. A measure of your general good fortune. It affects the recharge rate of critical hits.

quotes.name: Atomwheel Acrobats
quotes.flavor:
"If the acrobatic show doesn't wow the audience, we have no one to blame but our elves."
—Myra the Magnificent

quotes.name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
quotes.flavor: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

quotes.name: Costly Plunder
quotes.flavor: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

quotes.name: Culling Ritual
quotes.flavor: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

quotes.name: Wizened Mentor
quotes.flavor: It wasn't that his students were better; it was that his students had made *him* better.

quotes.name: Glorifier of Suffering
quotes.flavor: "Everyone wants to be remembered. Few are willing to do what it takes."

quotes.name: Aragorn, King of Gondor
quotes.flavor: "In this place will I abide, and my heirs, unto the ending of the world."

quotes.name: The Legend of Yangchen // Avatar Yangchen
quotes.flavor: "Selfless duty calls you to sacrifice your own spiritual needs and do whatever it takes to protect the world."

quotes.name: Woodland Champion
quotes.flavor: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

quotes.name: Mechanized Warfare
quotes.flavor: First the automatons reinforced depleted squads. Then they replaced them entirely.

quotes.name: Impolite Entrance
quotes.flavor: "We smelled you kith-twits makin' porridge in here! We love porridge! Give us your porridge!"

quotes.name: Reckoner's Bargain
quotes.flavor: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair—the sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.

quotes.name: Doc Ock's Henchmen
quotes.flavor: "Don't be a hero, Gary! We don't get paid enough for a scrap with Spider-Man!"

quotes.name: Outland Boar
quotes.flavor: The vibrant forest of Peema is awash with aether. Its animals are stronger, faster, and more aggressive than their counterparts elsewhere.

quotes.name: Sanctum Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

quotes.name: Goblin Chainwhirler
quotes.flavor: "The trick is, once you get moving, don't stop!"

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

quotes.name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
quotes.flavor: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

quotes.name: Zurgo, Thunder's Decree
quotes.flavor: "Hear me, Mardu! Our freedom is only beginning!"

quotes.name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
quotes.flavor: Titanbones found he received the greatest gifts in the littlest things.

quotes.name: Agent of Kotis
quotes.flavor:
"I trust Narset. I do not trust those she keeps counsel with."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

quotes.name: Endless Detour
quotes.flavor: After diverting around the eleventh construction barrier, the taxi driver began to suspect she was being herded into a trap.

quotes.name: Vitu-Ghazi Guildmage
quotes.flavor: "Preachers of freedom forget that conformity can be beautiful."

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

quotes.name: Essence Flare
quotes.flavor: Never underestimate the power of the soul unleashed.

quotes.name: Ulcerate
quotes.flavor:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Roc of Kher Ridges
quotes.flavor: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

quotes.name: Restless Dead
quotes.flavor:
The rich's heirs often thank them after death . . . but preferably not in person.
—Suq'Ata epigram

quotes.name: Zealous Persecution
quotes.flavor: "Rejoice! Your vile blood will help fulfill our righteous cause."

quotes.name: Aether Flash
quotes.flavor: As the foul beast appeared, arcane lightning crackled around it.

quotes.name: Maggot Therapy
quotes.flavor:
"If this is the cure, I'd hate to see the disease."
—Orim

quotes.name: Corrupt
quotes.flavor: "Most wise, most thoughtful, most powerful qadir," said the Gixian, "we offer whatever help we may give in your illustrious name."

quotes.name: Cascade Bluffs
quotes.flavor: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

quotes.name: Acrobatic Maneuver
quotes.flavor: Renegades find ever more creative ways to work around the Consulate's aether regulations.

quotes.name: Amethyst Dragon // Explosive Crystal
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"At least it's a beautiful way to die."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

quotes.name: Akroan Crusader
quotes.flavor: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.

quotes.name: It That Betrays
quotes.flavor: All will be harvested.

quotes.name: Disrupt
quotes.flavor: Oh, I'm sorry—did I break your concentration?

quotes.name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: All are welcome.

quotes.name: Puppet Strings
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

quotes.name: Brokers Initiate
quotes.flavor: Regarding the relative might of pen and sword, the official position of the Brokers is "Why choose?"

quotes.name: Arc Lightning
quotes.flavor: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Only one loyal subject did not fear the wrath of the Marchioness—her beloved "Fluffin."

quotes.name: Goblin Surprise
quotes.flavor: "Hey, your door's broken!"

quotes.name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
quotes.flavor:
"All the power of a maro-sorcerer, all the mindless fury of a pitlord. He is a perfect servant."
—Geyadrone Dihada

quotes.name: Pearl Shard
quotes.flavor: Leonin folktales claim it was brought from beyond the sky by the first kha.

quotes.name: Grand Abolisher
quotes.flavor: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

quotes.name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
quotes.flavor: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

quotes.name: Omniscience
quotes.flavor:
"In the arrogance of my youth, I believed I knew all there was to know. Now, my greatest wisdom is a humble awareness of all I have yet to learn."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Transmogrant Altar
quotes.flavor:
"The human body—like any other machine—can be stripped for parts."
—Ashnod

quotes.name: Welcoming Vampire
quotes.flavor: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

quotes.name: The Blue Spirit
quotes.flavor: To the Avatar, was the Blue Spirit a friend? A foe? Or something else entirely?

quotes.name: Falkenrath Torturer
quotes.flavor: "There was a time when our cages rang with wailing. Now only a handful of these whimpering fools remain."

quotes.name: Reduce to Ashes
quotes.flavor:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator

quotes.name: Mirror of Galadriel
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Your Quest stands upon the edge of a knife. Stray but a little and it will fail, to the ruin of all. Yet hope remains while all the Company is true."

quotes.name: Esper Origins // Summon: Esper Maduin
quotes.flavor: "I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: The Railroad is an organization dedicated to freeing synths from the influence of the Institute. Their HQ is a secret location found by following the Freedom Trail.

quotes.name: Colossal Majesty
quotes.flavor:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

quotes.name: Reverberate
quotes.flavor:
"I'm not indecisive. I just don't like to limit my options."
—Maxti, pyromancer

quotes.name: Arc Trail
quotes.flavor:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

quotes.name: Street Wraith
quotes.flavor: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

quotes.name: Skyhunter Skirmisher
quotes.flavor:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

quotes.name: Crux of Fate
quotes.flavor: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

quotes.name: Castle Embereth
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

quotes.name: Annie Joins Up
quotes.flavor: One last job, then she could retire in peace.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor:
"The subject of innovation will always be near and dear to my heart."
—Tony Stark

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

quotes.name: Valley Mightcaller
quotes.flavor: "There is no path to the Root Maze's center. Bard, sing a song while I create one."

quotes.name: Greater Werewolf
quotes.flavor:
"Two legs by day, four legs by night, eyes raging in storm-gotten might."
—Ancient Northland riddle

quotes.name: Ohran Yeti
quotes.flavor: When a snowdrift shows you its eyes, it's already too late.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor: Denied the peace of the Blessed Sleep, geists lash out at the living, and the cycle of anger and unrest continues unbroken.

quotes.name: Vindicate
quotes.flavor: Some convictions are so strong that the world must break to accommodate them.

quotes.name: Return to the Ranks
quotes.flavor:
「彼らを戦いへ赴かせるのは怒りではなく、誉れなのです。」
――ロアホールドの学部長、オーガスタ

quotes.name: Psionic Sliver
quotes.flavor: They evolved the ability to concentrate their neural activity into a single pulse, causing a disruptive but usually suicidal blast of psionic energy.

quotes.name: Awakened Amalgam
quotes.flavor:
"The fools have done it."
—Tishana

quotes.name: Shrivel
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever killed insects nibbling at your crops? I think that's what the Eldrazi believe they're doing to us."
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

quotes.name: Master of the Feast
quotes.flavor: I'll have whatever they're having!

quotes.name: Leinore, Autumn Sovereign
quotes.flavor: She keeps the festival's revels from faltering, infusing the witches' rituals with hope.

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "I am the Guardian of Thraben, and I claim my right to speak before the council."

quotes.name: March from the Tomb
quotes.flavor: They came from all walks of life, from every part of Zendikar, and they returned with one unifying cause.

quotes.name: Abbey Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"The darkness crawls with vampires and ghouls, but we are not without allies."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

quotes.name: Agent of Treachery
quotes.flavor: "The more secrets you have, the more easily you become my pawn."

quotes.name: Plated Rootwalla
quotes.flavor:
" . . . And the third little boar built his house out of rootwalla plates . . . ."
—Skyshroud children's story

quotes.name: Waker of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "Our foes are many and mighty, but not as many as the trees or as mighty as the sea."

quotes.name: Stormkeld Vanguard // Bear Down
quotes.flavor: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

quotes.name: War Effort
quotes.flavor:
Community is strength.
—Tenet of the Decree of Thunder

quotes.name: Hammer of Purphoros
quotes.flavor: All the world is Purphoros's anvil.

quotes.name: Growing Ranks
quotes.flavor:
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness."
—Trostani

quotes.name: Herald of the Sun
quotes.flavor: "Fear neither clouds nor darkness. The light shall overcome them all."

quotes.name: Stormblood Berserker
quotes.flavor: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

quotes.name: Bubbling Muck
quotes.flavor: The muck claims a hundred living things for each meager treasure it spews forth.

quotes.name: Traitorous Instinct
quotes.flavor: The horror lurched about like a puppet from a madman's nightmare, squeezing the life from its own kind.

quotes.name: Teferi's Protection
quotes.flavor: "I've walked a hundred worlds, but you are my universe."

quotes.name: Talon Sliver
quotes.flavor: "Keep them at sword's length!" Gerrard's order fell flat as each sliver's talon suddenly grew longer. "Hold on—break out the polearms!"

quotes.name: Invoke the Firemind
quotes.flavor: To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.

quotes.name: Forgotten Creation
quotes.flavor:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Ridgetop Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"The Skirk Ridge has many wonderful things to discover—like escape routes."
—Foothill guide

quotes.name: Sigiled Contender
quotes.flavor: "All right. Warm-ups are over."

quotes.name: Fencing Ace
quotes.flavor: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

quotes.name: Brood Sliver
quotes.flavor: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

quotes.name: Yavimaya Ancients
quotes.flavor:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Temple of Enlightenment
quotes.flavor: Once, a symbol of national pride. Now, used only for target practice.

quotes.name: Ripjaw Raptor
quotes.flavor: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
quotes.flavor: "You should have folded when you had the chance."

quotes.name: Torch Fiend
quotes.flavor: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

quotes.name: Hookhand Mariner // Riphook Raider
quotes.flavor: They weren't entirely wrong.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
quotes.flavor: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

quotes.name: Camaraderie
quotes.flavor:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

quotes.name: Golden Bear
quotes.flavor: The elvish scout was scrupulous about the truth. She told the traders that gold lay nearby.
